checks: Isolated synthetic tenant, complete resident and reviewer accounts, and zero-fee test service created; real password logins reach both actual apps

Real complete and incomplete signed-in server pages preserve normal Profile access and hand legacy bookmarks once to Valid ID; compact navigation keeps Valid ID after Profile and Google linking remains present

Actual hosted front-only publication persists trimmed corrected details and original bytes without changing Profile; double click and deliberately lost committed reply resolve one ID/version through owned-row Retry

Actual staff UI loads one private front image and confirmed details, approves through the caller-authorized RPC, and records the reviewer; resident success and sidebar refresh to verified with matching current/approved evidence

Hosted personal/address/employment/birthday/avatar/household changes persist after reopening; rejected-write fixture preserves edits; real household add/edit/remove leaves current ID approval unchanged
Real resident service form reads and previews approved front-only evidence and creates a v2 request linked to that exact submission; no back photo or payment record is required/created

Caller-authorized legacy two-sided publication and actual staff preview/approval remain supported; real service form decodes both private images and retains personal Profile link; original front-only evidence remains intact
